body.notify: Extends Epic `make-insrc-analysis-complete-used-right` (b9d5c5c40df5a574): building on its stories on sizing a request from what it touches (s2), handling by size (s3) and a broad analysis completing to a final report (s7), and on the code in src/analyze/planner (scope-band.ts, recursive.ts, validate.ts, render-catalog.ts), src/analyze/measure.ts and src/analyze/executor.

addedStory.title: A request's size decides how deep and detailed its plan is, and a plan is checked to be executable
addedStory.userValue: Someone asking a broad question about a large codebase gets a plan that is wide and shallow and that the analyzer can finish, while someone asking about a small area gets a plan that goes deep, so a broad analysis reaches its final report in a reasonable time instead of spending the run inside deeper and deeper child plans.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A request that measures XL or L
acceptanceCriteria.then: the plan is breadth-first: many shallow, inexpensive tasks across the areas, and no area is explored by a child plan that is itself a large plan

acceptanceCriteria.given: A request that measures M or S
acceptanceCriteria.then: the plan is depth-first: fewer areas, each examined in detail, and child plans are allowed where they add depth

acceptanceCriteria.given: A plan whose child plans, taken together, would exceed what the request's size allows
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is refused with a reason that names the total and the limit, so that the planner can correct it, in the same way a wrong task count is refused today

acceptanceCriteria.given: A plan accepted for a broad request
acceptanceCriteria.then: the executor works within a budget set by the request's size and the run says when a budget was reached, instead of running on with no bound

acceptanceCriteria.given: The broad docs request on this repository, which measured XL
acceptanceCriteria.when: it is run end to end
acceptanceCriteria.then: it reaches a final report within a stated time and says in its record how deep the plan went and how many tasks ran

nextAction.description: Approve the HLD amendment (`AMD-b9d5c5c40df5a574-2`) and the updated Epic, then run `design.story` for the new Story `s9` to produce its LLD.
